description: Collect everything the watch tools have found: call it to drain the changeset for every watch owned by your API key, most severe first. Company watches return an 'updated' entry with the changed fields and risk; CAEN and county watches return the 'new' companies registered since the last poll (200 a poll, the rest next).
name: poll_watchlist

outputSchema.description: What changed for your watches since the last poll, most severe first.

active.description: Every watch you hold, changed or not: kind (company or caen), target (CUI or code), county, since, name. Remove one with unwatch.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

email_alerts.description: How to get the same changes by email.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

owner.description: Whose watches these are (key prefix or IP).

watches.description: Per watch: an 'updated' company with its changed fields and risk, or the 'new' companies registered in a watched activity.

title: Collect watchlist changes
